name: Wish -Tale of the Sixteenth Night of Lunar Month-
source:
The protagonist, Tenka Kurono, is an adopted son of the Kurono family, who has been managing the Kuromiya Shrine for several generations. His older sister Mutsuki and upperclassman Rinna are runemasters - prana users who have been defending the land of commoners since ancient times. Alas, Tenka himself has no special powers, but his daily life is about to be shattered when he starts hearing his name being called in a dream...

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/392370/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
主角黑野天香是黑宫家族的养子，代代经营着黑宫神社。他的姐姐睦月和学长凛奈是符文大师——自古以来守护平民土地的魔力使者。唉，天香本人并没有特殊能力，但当他开始在梦中听到自己的名字被叫到时，他的日常生活即将被打破……

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/392370/]蒸汽[/url]]
